import csv, collections
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('data.csv')))
cart = collections.Counter(); paid = collections.Counter()
for r in rows:
    key = (r['ts'][:10], r['device'], r['browser'])
    (cart if r['step'] == 'cart' else paid)[key] += 1
cohorts = sorted({(p, b) for (_, p, b) in cart})
print('platform  browser  oct13   oct14   delta')
tot = {'2026-10-13': [0, 0], '2026-10-14': [0, 0]}
for p, b in cohorts:
    a = paid[('2026-10-13', p, b)] / cart[('2026-10-13', p, b)] * 100
    c = paid[('2026-10-14', p, b)] / cart[('2026-10-14', p, b)] * 100
    print(f'{p:<9} {b:<8} {a:5.1f}%  {c:5.1f}%  {c-a:+.1f} pts')
for d in tot:
    tot[d][0] = sum(v for k, v in cart.items() if k[0] == d); tot[d][1] = sum(v for k, v in paid.items() if k[0] == d)
a = tot['2026-10-13'][1] / tot['2026-10-13'][0] * 100; c = tot['2026-10-14'][1] / tot['2026-10-14'][0] * 100
print(f'overall              {a:5.1f}%  {c:5.1f}%  {c-a:+.1f} pts')
